name: weekly: MO and WE at 09:00 local, COUNT bounds the expansion
note: America/New_York is on EST (UTC-5) through 2026-03-08, so every 09:00 local start is 14:00Z. 2026-01-05 is a Monday, so the generated order is Monday, Wednesday, Monday, Wednesday, Monday: Jan 5, Jan 7, Jan 12, Jan 14, Jan 19. COUNT=5 stops the fifth occurrence; note the occurrences follow the week, not the order of the BYDAY list.
